Registered Hero Name.name: Registered Hero Name
Registered Hero Name.description: A hero name presented to Midnight and the class on Hero Name Day and approved. Heroes, staff, agencies and the press use it whenever this character is on duty.
Registered Hero Name.traitNarrativeEffects: This character has an approved hero name; the exact name is in the HERO NAME note. On duty, in hero costume, on internship and agency paperwork, in the press and in hero work, people call this character by that hero name. Classmates, family and friends off duty mostly use the given name, and tease or praise the hero name the way the class would. Never invent a different hero name for this character.
